items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I applied that lesson to my son many years later, when he was in school in England.

ctx.x: That’s not you, so why get mad?

That’s not me. What are you getting mad at? Because if you’re mad, then you’re a nigger. I said, no, that ain’t me. So then I learned, I’m not going to get mad. I applied that lesson to my son many years later, when he was in school in England. I took my four kids to London. We’ll get to that later. He got kicked out of four schools. It cost me a lot of money. I finally asked him, “What is it? What is the matter with you?” He said, “He called me a nigger.” I said, “Hey, I’m a nigger. So you are a nigger.” I said,…
